scripts.copydeps: copyfiles -u 4 node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/* static/fonts && copyfiles -u 1 public/* static/
scripts.dev: yarn run copydeps && esbuild public/index.js --bundle --watch=forever --outfile=static/index.js & sass --watch sass:static/css &
scripts.build: yarn run copydeps && sass sass:static/css && esbuild public/index.js --bundle --minify --outfile=static/index.js
